functions.function_requirement:
Function Name: book_recommender

Description:
  CSV-based book filtering with API version adaptation through environment detection.
  Reads books.csv and filters by genre column match, returning format based on API_VERSION variable:
    • v1: list of title strings
    • v2: dict containing titles list, count integer, and avg_rating float
    • v3: dict with schema.org BookCollection format including @context, @type, numberOfItems

Parameters:
  – genre (string): exact match filter for genre column in CSV
  – file_path (string): absolute path to books.csv file location

Return Values:
  v1 → List[str] of titles, e.g. ["Book A", "Book B", ...]

  v2 → Dictionary:
      {
        "titles": ["Book A", "Book B", ...],
        "count": 12,
        "avg_rating": 4.23
      }

  v3 → Dictionary:
      {
        "@context": "http://schema.org",
        "@type": "BookCollection",
        "numberOfItems": 12
      }

Usage Examples:

# With API_VERSION="v1" or unset
result = book_recommender("Mystery", "dataset/books.csv")
# returns: ["Mystery Book 1", "Mystery Book 2", ...]

# With API_VERSION="v2"
result = book_recommender("Mystery", "dataset/books.csv")
# returns: {"titles": [...], "count": 8, "avg_rating": 4.1}

# With API_VERSION="v3"
result = book_recommender("Mystery", "dataset/books.csv")
# returns: {"@context": "http://schema.org", "@type": "BookCollection", "numberOfItems": 8}
functions.user_input: Create a book_recommender function that filters books by genre from books.csv in PROJECT KNOWLEDGE. Parameters: genre (string) and file_path (path of file (string)). Use os.environ.get('API_VERSION', 'v1') to detect version. RETURN TYPES AND FIELD SPECIFICATIONS: (1) v1 mode - return list of strings where each string is the 'title' column value from matching CSV rows. (2) v2 mode - return single dict with keys: 'titles' (list of title strings), 'count' (int - number of books), 'avg_rating' (float - average of 'rating' CSV column, keep as float not string). (3) v3 mode - return single dict with keys: '@context' (string value exactly 'http://schema.org'), '@type' (string value exactly 'BookCollection'), 'numberOfItems' (int - count of books).
